gold_statement: The system shall display drug-drug and drug-allergy interaction alerts before a medication order can be signed.
statement: The system shall perform real-time drug-drug interaction and allergy contraindication checking at the point of ordering.

gold_statement: The system shall allow a prescriber to change a transmitted prescription through an RxChangeRequest message.
statement: The system shall allow the prescriber to change or cancel an e-Rx before it is transmitted.

gold_statement: The system shall send new prescriptions to the e-prescribing intermediary as NCPDP SCRIPT NewRx messages.
statement: The system shall allow a prescriber to issue an electronic prescription for a patient.

gold_statement: The system shall reach the e-prescribing intermediary acknowledgement within 10 seconds of signing for 95% of prescriptions.
statement: The system shall transmit the e-Rx to a community pharmacy through an e-prescribing intermediary.

gold_statement: The system shall retain audit logs and security documentation for at least 6 years.
statement: The system shall retain all e-Rx records for at least two years from the date of their creation or receipt.
